$comment: 01.7.1-T4.2 (AC6): vulnerability-scan allowlist consumed by scripts/audit-deps.sh. Keyed by advisory id (GHSA-xxxx-yyyy-zzzz or CVE-YYYY-NNNNN — the last path segment of the advisory URL from 'npm audit --json' or 'dotnet list package --vulnerable --format json'). Every entry must name the accepting ADR (adr), the affected package, and the reason; 'expires' (YYYY-MM-DD) is optional — an expired exception no longer exempts. An empty object means no exceptions: every vulnerability found by the scanners fails the gate.

GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf.reason: No patched release exists (affected <=4.0.7, patched none; latest published 4.0.7). The only --omit=dev chain is the web build/localization tooling via @angular/localize -> tinyglobby -> picomatch; no browser, server or customer-side runtime path was found, and exploitation needs an attacker-controlled glob pattern, which that tooling takes only from repository config or a developer command. Build-time risk accepted until 2026-12-18; ends early on a patched release or any new production chain that passes untrusted patterns.
